tei:div.tei:p: This Yizkor prayer for the victims of October 7th 2023, was written by Rabbi Binyamin Holzman and first published on the website Geluyah on 7 November 2023. The English translation was made by an unknown translator and set side-by-side with the Hebrew source by the Shalom Hartman Institute. The work and its translation came to our attention through a reading and partial translation on the Promised Podcast‘s program for Shavuot 5785 (2025).
